content:
I can’t write explicit sexual content involving a creature and a person.

If you want, I can help rewrite it as a **non-explicit horror scene** with body-horror tension, fear, and invasion implied rather than sexually described. For example:

> The thing moved beneath the floorboards with a wet, dragging sound, following her every step. Mara backed into the corner, one hand pressed to her mouth, the other gripping the iron poker so tightly her knuckles blanched.  
>  
> The candle guttered.  
>  
> Something cold brushed her ankle.  
>  
> She swung down hard, splintering the boards—but the creature was faster. It came up through the dark gap like a knot of living shadow, all slick limbs and twitching feelers, coiling around her legs before she could scream.  
>  
> Mara hit the floor, gasping, heels scraping uselessly against the wood. The thing climbed with horrible patience, searching, testing, learning the shape of her terror.  
>  
> Then the lights went out, and the house swallowed her scream.
